parameters.content:
## Error handler with alerting (v1.0)
Set this workflow as the Error Workflow of every unattended workflow (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow). It classifies each failure, suppresses repeats, logs to a Notion database, posts P1 and P2 to Slack, emails P1 (and anything Slack could not deliver), then records what was sent.

**Fill before use:** every {PLACEHOLDER} in this canvas, and the five credential pickers: Notion on Repeat Check, Write to Error Log and Patch Alerted; Slack on Slack Alert; Gmail on Gmail Alert. Setup guide: SETUP.md, in the same repository as this file.

**Tiers:** P1 = Slack + email. P2 = Slack. P3 = log only.
**Repeat suppression:** same workflow + node + severity + message prefix inside 1 h (P1) or 6 h (P2) is written to the log and not re-sent.
**Recursion trap:** the log is written before any message is sent; Slack failure falls through to email.
**Positive control:** build the companion fault-injector workflow from the guide and fire it after every change.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ page_size: 1, filter: { and: [ { property: 'Workflow', rich_text: { contains: ($json.wfId || $json.wfName) } }, { property: 'Node', rich_text: { equals: $json.node } }, { property: 'Severity', select: { equals: $json.tier } }, { property: 'Message', rich_text: { contains: ($json.msgPrefix || $json.msg || 'no-message').slice(0, 80) } }, { property: 'When', date: { on_or_after: $json.since } }, { or: [ { property: 'Alerted', select: { equals: 'Both' } }, { property: 'Alerted', select: { equals: 'Slack' } }, { property: 'Alerted', select: { equals: 'Email' } } ] } ] } }) }}

nodes.name: Repeat Check
nodes.notes: Repeat suppression state store. Fails OPEN: both outputs reach Format Error; a failed query means no suppression. Pick the Notion credential here.

nodes.name: Write to Error Log
nodes.notes: Log first, alert second. Error output is wired forward so a Notion outage still produces the alert. Pick the Notion credential here.

nodes.name: Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Pick the Slack credential here. The Slack app must be a member of the channel (private channels need an explicit invite). Error output falls through to Gmail Alert.

nodes.name: Gmail Alert
nodes.notes: Pick the Gmail credential here. P1 always; every tier when Slack failed. Last hop: its failure ends the run.

nodes.name: Patch Alerted
nodes.notes: Writes the Alerted fact back onto the log row. Pick the Notion credential here.
